kind: other
depth: focused
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = var.name
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

output "queue_url" {
  value = aws_sqs_queue.this.url
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
-- base/wrappers/main.tf --
module "wrapper" {
  source   = "../"
  for_each = var.items
  name     = each.value.name
}

output "wrapper" {
  value = module.wrapper
}

variable "items" {
  type = any
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = var.name
  message_retention_seconds = 120
}

output "queue_url" {
  value = aws_sqs_queue.this.url
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
-- head/wrappers/main.tf --
module "wrapper" {
  source   = "../"
  for_each = var.items
  name     = each.value.name
}

output "wrapper" {
  value = module.wrapper
}

variable "items" {
  type = any
}
